description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", spans from 2.5 to 10.0 with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 25 to 33, with grid lines and tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The "Consistency-CE" model is represented by a purple line with circular markers, starting at approximately 26.0 BLEU at AL=2.5 and rising to about 31.0 BLEU at AL=10.0. The "Inconsistency-CE" model is shown as a magenta line with square markers, beginning at around 26.0 BLEU and increasing to approximately 31.5 BLEU. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" model is depicted by a blue line with square markers, starting at roughly 26.0 BLEU and ending near 32.0 BLEU. The "Consistency-Bi" model is represented by a red line with star markers, beginning at about 29.0 BLEU and rising to approximately 32.0 BLEU. All lines show a generally increasing trend as AL increases.
